title: Skills Development
text: How Does It Operate? The Skills Development Scorecard evaluates monetary expenditure on black candidates and the number of black individuals enrolled in Learnerships and structured work-based learning programs. In essence, it emphasizes achieving targets related to (i) training expenses (in relation to total payroll) and (ii) headcount (in relation to total staff count) for those undergoing training. Additionally, note that certain sector scorecards necessitate ICT skills training to qualify, a requirement seamlessly met by the Zaio Programmes.
